title: Real-time greetings
summary: The input event is triggered when the user types, pastes or deletes content. Read the value of the input box in the callback to get the current text.
tasks: listens to the input event of the #student input box and reads the name with the leading and trailing spaces removed.
Set #greeting to “Hello, NAME!” using the trimmed name. Use “Hello, classmate!” when the field is empty.
hint: Use field.value.trim() to get the name, and use if or || to handle empty content. Pay attention to full-width punctuation.
goal: allows the greeting text to be updated in real time with the input box, and the general greeting will be restored when cleared.

example.note: The registration page updates the team name preview as you enter. After clearing the team name, the preview shows "Unnamed team".
